title: Pending account created upon successful registration
gherkin:
Feature: Pending Account Creation
  Scenario: New account receives Pending status after registration
    Given a user completes the registration form with valid credentials
    When the registration form is successfully submitted
    Then a new user account is created
    And the account status is set to Pending
rationale: Validates the foundational requirement that accounts are created with Pending status upon successful registration, establishing the starting point of the Pending account lifecycle.
usedContextItems: Upon successful submission of the registration form, the system shall create a new user account with a status of Pending.|Accounts are created with Pending status upon successful registration before email verification
